### Final Exam, Part 2
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-7-2016.html
Passage: Genesis 44:33-34
Points:
- Joseph tested his brothers to see whether they would abandon Benjamin or sacrifice themselves for him.
- Judah, who years earlier proposed selling Joseph into slavery, stepped forward to intercede for his youngest brother.
- He offered to become an enslaved captive in Egypt so Benjamin could safely return to their father.
- Judah's willingness to lay down his freedom demonstrated that deep repentance had genuinely transformed him.

### Judah Steps Forward
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judah-steps-forward
Passage: Genesis 44:18-29
Points:
- Judah stepped forward to address Joseph with humility and reverence despite the extreme peril of the situation.
- He openly acknowledged his father's deep affection for Benjamin without letting past favoritism provoke jealousy.
- Rather than repeating past callousness, Judah honored his father by defending the brother who was favored.
- Believers are urged to release lingering resentment over favoritism or rejection, resting instead in God's love.
